title: EngineError
description: The structured error value carried in a ResponseFrame's 'error' member. Errors are values: this is the only way an operation fails. Taxonomy and details conventions in spec.md §10.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Open vocabulary; unknown codes are handled by the category fallback (spec.md §10.2).

category.description: Coarse classification enabling handling of unknown codes. Absent or unknown is treated as 'internal'.

message.description: Human-readable description, not intended for programmatic dispatch. With a 'chain', the complete sentence: normally its layers' messages joined.

details.description: Code-specific structure per spec.md §10.2 — e.g. 'supported' (protocol-version-unsupported), 'op' (operation-unsupported), 'problems: [{path, message}]' (interaction-invalid/contract-invalid), 'component' and opaque 'error' (component-*).

chain.description: Its layers, outermost first (spec.md §10.1, ADR 0054): the first is this error itself and the last its root cause, each in its own words only. A host reading only 'message' loses nothing; one reading the chain can tell what failed from why. Absent when the error has no cause worth a layer.

items.title: ErrorLayer
items.description: One layer of an error: what it says, in its own words, and its code when it has one.

code.description: The layer's code, when it has one a host can look up. Open vocabulary: an EngineError's codes, or, in the layers a component's error brought, a ComponentError's.

message.description: What this layer says, without its causes' words.
